newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 3,246 to dollar for Sept 26 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 3,246 to dollar for Sept 26 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 3,246 to the dollar for September 26.
This reference rate was set on Tuesday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Monday for September 25 is 3,245 to the dollar. It was 3,234 on Tuesday.
